thread:
Anya (PM): ok quick sync — we need to lock what goes into the next ship window. TL;DR: pick a minimal launch set so we don't slip the SLA-backed customers, but preserve a clear v1 backlog.
Sam L (Eng): +1. main risks: multi-model routing & dynamic quant profiles are the two big infra lifts. both add ~3-4 sprint effort each.
Leila - Eng: also latency risk. routing adds ~12-18% p50 for some tail requests unless we do smarter KV caching first.
Jong Park (Product): Proposed split: Launch = essential generation + embeddings + simple routing (static per-customer). Defer dynamic routing and auto-quant until v1. keeps commit dates intact. thoughts?
Maya (Design): Design note: function/tool-calling UI needs a small affordance to show "fallback model used" if routing falls back. If we defer dynamic routing, we still need the UI hook.
Anya (PM): agree with Jong. we must keep our committed SLA customers happy. we can ship the UI hook as a tiny flagged change.
Sam L (Eng): if we ship static routing, cost impact is predictable. dynamic routing refund would be a separate opt-in later. I can draft the engineering acceptance criteria.
Leila - Eng: acceptance criteria suggestions:
- p50 <= 120ms for short prompts; p95 <= 600ms under 80% load
- fallback to regional model if primary unavailable within 500ms
- telemetry tags for model-variant and routing-decisions
Anya (PM): love those. add rollout plan: canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% over two weeks.
Jong Park (Product): customers pushing for streaming and lower token cost. we should keep the Optimize recommendations work in the v1 backlog but add a "cost playbook" doc for SREs now.
Maya (Design): small UX checklist I can deliver:
```
- show model variant label
- show fallback notice (brief)
- enterprise opt-out switch in settings
```
Sam L (Eng): i'll own rollout infra + canary. Leila will own SLO validation and telemetry. Anya will coordinate stakeholder comms.
Leila - Eng: quick note — need to disable auto-batching heuristics for canary traffic to get stable measurements. flagging now.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: canary/feature-ship-window -> infra-team (ETA in 2h) :rocket:
Anya (PM): ACTIONS:
- Sam: draft eng acceptance criteria and timeline by EOD (1785014000)
- Leila: telemetry schema + SLO smoke tests by tomorrow (1785090000)
- Maya: deliver UX checklist + microcopy by EOD
- Jong: update sales-facing doc to reflect "static routing launch"
Agree? :thumbsup:
Sam L (Eng): 👍
Leila - Eng: 👍
Maya (Design): 👍
Jong Park (Product): 👍
Anya (PM): ok locking this. we'll call this the "static-routing launch plan" and treat dynamic routing + auto-quant as scoped v1 initiatives. if any blocker shows, ping #eng-oncall and mark the timeline doc.
